purpose: Fresh clean proof of fanout-to-XLSX composition after typed file-context binding repair.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_USERS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_USERS.json. Read the live JSON array from that result. For every user returned at runtime, if that user's username length is at most 8 characters generate a QR code image encoding that username; otherwise generate a Code 128 barcode image encoding that username. Save each selected image under canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_CODES using the user's id as the filename, and create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_MANIFEST.json with exactly one record per live user containing id, username, selected capability kind, and artifact path. Then create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN.xlsx from canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_MANIFEST.json with columns id, username, capability_kind, and artifact_path. Independently reopen the XLSX and verify it contains exactly one row per manifest record and every value is identical. Finally independently decode every generated image and verify each decoded value equals that live user's username, every live user has exactly one artifact, and no extra manifest records exist.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,zipfile,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
manifest_path=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN_MANIFEST.json')
xlsx_path=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_JOIN.xlsx')
assert manifest_path.is_file(), 'MANIFEST_MISSING'
assert xlsx_path.is_file(), 'XLSX_MISSING'
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert isinstance(manifest,list) and manifest, 'MANIFEST_INVALID'
NS={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
with zipfile.ZipFile(xlsx_path,'r') as z:
    shared=[]
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('m:si',NS):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iterfind('.//m:t',NS)))
    sheet=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    rows=[]
    for row in sheet.findall('.//m:sheetData/m:row',NS):
        vals=[]
        for cell in row.findall('m:c',NS):
            typ=cell.get('t')
            v=cell.find('m:v',NS)
            raw='' if v is None or v.text is None else v.text
            if typ=='s' and raw:
                val=shared[int(raw)]
            elif typ=='inlineStr':
                val=''.join(t.text or '' for t in cell.iterfind('.//m:t',NS))
            else:
                val=raw
            vals.append(val)
        rows.append(vals)
assert rows, 'WORKBOOK_EMPTY'
header=[str(x) for x in rows[0]]
expected_header=['id','username','capability_kind','artifact_path']
assert header==expected_header,(header,expected_header)
actual=[dict(zip(header,row)) for row in rows[1:]]
expected=[{k:r[k] for k in expected_header} for r in manifest]
assert len(actual)==len(expected),(len(actual),len(expected))
for a,e in zip(actual,expected):
    assert str(a['id']).rstrip('.0')==str(e['id']),(a,e)
    for k in ('username','capability_kind','artifact_path'):
        assert str(a[k])==str(e[k]),(k,a,e)
print('FANOUT_XLSX_JOIN_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
